name: AICostBudget AI API Pricing Dataset
statistics_scope: public pricing records returned by the public pricing adapter with Pricing V2 enabled
null_value_meaning: Not listed, not published, not applicable, or not currently available in the dataset; null is not zero.

features.pricing_components: Full conditional pricing components; [] when none apply.
features.pricing_components_json: Compact CSV JSON serialization of pricing_components.
features.time_pricing: Structured request-time pricing schedule; null when no temporal pricing applies.
features.time_pricing_json: Compact CSV JSON serialization of time_pricing.
features.unit_price: Primary non-token unit price; null for token-priced rows.
